wallet_deployed_by_factory_occurred.meaning: BuilderFactory.deployBuilder() deployed a BuilderWallet and called init(legitimateAdmin)

init_called_by_attacker.meaning: init() was invoked with the attacker's own address as the builder admin

caller_is_authorized_initializer.meaning: the caller of init() is the factory or an authorized initializer

admin_set_to_attacker.meaning: the builder admin was set to the attacker's own address via init()

assumptions: The attacker's init() call is the checked action; the factory's own init(legitimateAdmin) is the lawful baseline.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker's init() overwrites an existing admin or succeeds only when init() was not yet called; the guard's exact precondition on prior initialization is unspecified.
Report does not fix a single required guard form (onlyFactory vs constructor-set admin); the authorization predicate is a report-grounded Boolean for the required restriction.

limitations: The impact is potential; the pattern encodes the report-supported conditional scenario in which the attacker calls init() with their own address and the admin is set to the attacker.
Authorization is represented as a report-grounded Boolean because the report does not fix a single concrete guard implementation.
